Papers.AnsariRockel2024.raftery_cdf.type:

Papers.AnsariRockel2024.tEV_cdf_interior.type:

        Real.exp
          (-(-Real.log ↑u *
                Verification.studentTCDF (ν + 1) (Verification.tEVArg ν r ((-Real.log ↑u / -Real.log ↑v) ^ (1 / ν))) +
              -Real.log ↑v *
                Verification.studentTCDF (ν + 1) (Verification.tEVArg ν r ((-Real.log ↑v / -Real.log ↑u) ^ (1 / ν)))))

Papers.AnsariRockel2024.tEV_pickands.type:
